site.title: be-water · Agent-first multi-tenant SaaS foundation
site.tagline: Shapeless as water, it takes the form of its container
site.description: be-water is an agent-first multi-tenant SaaS modular monolith: AGENTS.md, Skills, and a gen/check loop let coding agents extend the product inside enforced boundaries; the kernel stays business-free, modules toggle per tenant, one process in production.

hero.headline: An agent-first multi-tenant SaaS foundation
hero.subline: AGENTS.md, Skills, and a gen/check loop let coding agents extend the product inside enforced boundaries; the kernel stays business-free, modules toggle per tenant, one process in production.

bot.title: Agent-first loop
bot.description: AGENTS.md and Skills are part of the product: fill a Spec → gen:module → check:modules so coding agents extend inside gates—not by luck.

layers.title: Kernel stays business-free
layers.description: HTTP stack, auth, tenant context, module loader, and event bus live in the kernel—zero business code mixed in. Swap the product without touching the foundation.

blocks.title: Modules plug in cleanly
blocks.description: Each module ships server routes, client pages, and shared contracts. Register in both enabled-modules lists to go live; remove just as cleanly.

plug.title: Per-tenant toggles
plug.description: Modules and entitlements open per tenant: disabled means no routes, no sidebar, no data—and quota overruns are blocked by the kernel.

shield.title: Tenant isolation is mandatory
shield.description: Tenant guards fail-closed at the Prisma layer: unregistered models block startup, with lint and runtime checks against cross-tenant access.

server.title: Single-process deployment
server.description: Assembled at compile time, one process in production, delivered with Docker Compose. No microservice ops tax, no low-code ceiling.

agentFirst.title: One loop for humans and agents
agentFirst.description: Not another scaffold dump: structured Specs, one-shot wiring, and machine gates so Cursor / Claude Code extend modules inside the lines.

spec.title: Fill the Spec
spec.description: Declare module id, permissions, models, and entitlements; blanks mean the agent must ask—no guessing.

gen.title: Generate and wire
gen.description: Scaffold plus six registry touchpoints in one pass—no silent missing routes or tenant guards.

check.title: Machine gates
check.description: Contract and dependency checks catch overreach and missed wiring; CI runs the same suite.

builtinModules.title: Infrastructure ready to go
builtinModules.description: Auth, tenants, permissions, audit, notifications, jobs, observability—everything every SaaS rebuilds from scratch, already modular and toggleable.

techStack.title: A predictable stack
techStack.description: Mainstream, long-maintained choices: easy to hire for, easy to search, clear upgrade paths. Value is in boundaries and constraints—not novelty frameworks.

closingCta.title: Run the foundation, then let agents extend it
closingCta.description: Five minutes locally; ship modules through Spec → gen → check. The free tier can stay free.

pricing.pageDescription: Seat-based billing with per-tenant module toggles. Stay on free as long as you need; upgrades change quotas, not migrations.
pricing.footnote: Prices are CNY monthly, tax included, with annual discounts. Every plan includes full infrastructure modules and security updates.

highlights: All infrastructure modules (auth, audit, notifications, jobs)

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Plans are adjusted per tenant in the platform console. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades apply after the current billing cycle without affecting existing data.

items.question: How are seats counted?
items.answer: A seat is an active user in the tenant. Disabled users do not consume seats; adding users beyond the limit is blocked with an upgrade prompt.

items.question: Do you support private deployment?
items.answer: Yes. be-water is a single-process modular monolith, delivered with Docker Compose in production. Enterprise supports your own servers or private cloud.

items.question: Can I buy only some modules?
items.answer: Modules toggle per tenant; plans define default scope. Enterprise can mix as needed—disabled modules have no routes, sidebar entries, or data.

info.code: Rendered as monospace code, e.g. a shell command.
info.copyright: Leave empty to auto-generate “© year site name”.
info.padding: Desktop value; scaled down on narrow screens
info.anchor: Leave blank for none. With "pricing", link here via /#pricing
info.content_width: Full bleed + unconstrained gives edge-to-edge media; colored bands usually keep content at page width.
info.spacing: Distance to the neighbouring section; “Inherit” follows the site-wide section spacing.
info.doc_category_filter: Enter a category exactly as used on the documents; leave empty to list all.
info.doc_limit: 0 means no limit. Use it for a "latest docs" block on the home page.
info.doc_show_title: The title comes from document metadata; start the body at ##.
info.doc_back_label: Leave blank for the built-in wording, which follows the visitor's language.
info.doc_back_href: Leave blank to link back to the docs index at /docs.
info.doc_nav_sticky: Wide screens only — on narrow ones the columns stack, and a stuck menu would push the body off screen.
info.columns_layout: Drag a split point to set how many of the row’s 12 units each column takes. Desktop only — columns stack on narrow screens. Add or remove columns in the structure tree.
info.sticky_column: The column stays in view while the other column scrolls. Best for a menu or a short summary.
info.column_divider: Draws a vertical rule between this column and the one to its right, running the full height of the row. Each column carries its own — the last one has none, as there is nothing on its right to separate.
info.divider_color: Leave empty to follow the theme border colour.
info.stack_order: Only affects narrow screens, where columns stack vertically.
info.page_title: Shown in the browser tab and search results; the page-header section falls back to it.
info.page_description: The snippet in search results; keep it under ~150 characters.
info.page_path: Change the address from the page list — a new path means a new URL.
info.page_header_headline: Leave empty to use the title from page settings.
info.page_header_subhead: Leave empty to use the description from page settings.
info.bg_color: Leave empty for no custom fill. Supports alpha (e.g. #0f766e80).
info.outer_bg_color: Band shell fill (not the padding ring). Leave empty for none; supports alpha.
info.inner_bg_color: Content-area fill — the padding ring uses this color too. Leave empty for transparent so the outer background shows through.
info.border_width: 0 hides the custom border. Setting a border color with width 0 draws a 1px border.
info.radius: Inherit keeps the default corner radius for this surface.
info.spacing_box: Outer values are space to neighbouring sections (can inherit the site default). Inner values are content padding (same layer as the inner background). Desktop values; scaled on narrow screens.
info.page_bg_color: Colors the page content area only; header and footer keep their own settings.
info.show_account: Shows “Sign in” when signed out, and an account menu once signed in. Hidden on sites without members.
info.show_locale_switcher: Only appears when this page has translations. Whether a page is translated is decided in the page list; this only controls the button.
info.show_theme_toggle: The site always follows the visitor's device preference. Turn this on to also give them a manual switch. Off does not force light mode.
info.success_message: Leave empty to show just a checkmark.
info.field_options: One per line; used by “Dropdown” only.
info.field_wide: Narrow screens are always single column; this affects desktop only.
info.field_pattern: Used only when the rule is “Custom regex”. No // delimiters needed.
info.field_max_length: 0 means follow the default (200 single-line / 4000 long text).
info.og_image: Shown when the page is shared on social platforms. Falls back to the site default; 1200×630 recommended.
info.noindex: The page stays reachable — it just won't appear in search results or the sitemap.
info.site_og_image: Used by every page without its own. Avoid reusing the logo — square images get cropped in share cards.
info.header_menu: The links in your header — add, remove and reorder them below. Footer columns can copy this list.
info.column_title: Optional heading above this column’s links.
info.show_doc_search: Puts a search box in the header that jumps to the doc index filtered by the term. It is the only doc search entry point; hidden until the site has published docs.
